title: Require Civ7 API Source Topology
forbids: an open or handwritten Civ7 API package that mixes official declarations, realm activation, host generation, or unrelated runtime logic
why: Official API authority remains inspectable only when generated module shards, disjoint realm entries, provenance, and finite contract proof occupy closed qualified destinations beneath the shared package shell.
remediate: Regenerate packages/civ7-api through civ7-api-materializer and move host acquisition, Tuner, controller, or product behavior to their qualified owners.
message: The generated Civ7 API must preserve its closed official-knowledge topology.
